items.title: Tribal Groups Urge Congress to Halt Bill That Threatens Sacred Sites
items.summary: The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act would speed up permitting for major projects and could impact Indigenous sovereignty over culturally significant land.

items.title: The Alchemical Possibilities of an Artist-Poet Collaboration
items.summary: Four decades later, El Museo del Barrio restages Papo Colo's text-and-image show "Octopus and Others."

items.title: Botanical Artists Show Us What We Stand to Lose
items.summary: Works at the American Society of Botanical Artists' annual exhibition radiate with majesty, and the intricate sumptuousness is agonizing.

items.title: Seven Museums to Host Solo Exhibitions Celebrating Wolf Kahn’s Centennial
items.summary: Museums in Germany, New York, and Vermont are among those to honor the late abstract landscape painter next year.
